A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.cost_latency: measure local CPU seconds, RAM and per-pair latency
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.hypothesis: Content can corroborate event identity, but semantic similarity alone can conflate topic and event.
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.inputs: normalized title + newline + D2E3 normalized content; full representation capped at 8192 Unicode codepoints
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.missing: unavailable; named fallback is evaluated separately
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.representation: local bi-encoder proposal; fixed preprocessing and model identity require approval
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.reproducibility: pin model/tokenizer/digest, CPU backend, seeds and preprocessing
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.scoring: similarity is candidate evidence, not standalone merge proof
A_CONTENT_AWARE_SEMANTIC_CONFIRMATION.threshold: training folds only; numeric rule pending PM

B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.cost_latency: measure extraction CPU, RAM and pair comparison latency
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.hypothesis: Typed event-specific action, entity and contradiction evidence distinguishes same subject from same occurrence.
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.inputs: title and frozen content; typed entities, actions, dates, identifiers, numbers and locations
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.missing: missing is unknown, never positive evidence
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.representation: versioned deterministic language-aware extraction proposed; NER requires separate approval
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.reproducibility: freeze lexicon, pattern set, normalization and versions before labels
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.scoring: typed agreement and explicit contradictions; no entity-only confirmation
B_EVENT_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT.threshold: training folds only; numeric rule pending PM

C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.hypothesis: Semantic evidence plus independent event corroboration and contradiction veto may reduce false merges.
C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.inputs: A semantic evidence and B typed anchors
C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.representation: semantic gate + anchor confirmation + contradiction veto proposed
C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.reproducibility: pin A and B configurations, veto rules and versions before labels
C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.scoring: no positive result from missing anchors; alternative gates require preregistration
C_CONTENT_EVENT_ANCHOR_HYBRID.threshold: training folds only; numeric rule pending PM

D_PAIRWISE_RERANKER_REFERENCE_HOLD.hypothesis: A local cross-encoder might improve reference discrimination.
D_PAIRWISE_RERANKER_REFERENCE_HOLD.reproducibility: pin model/tokenizer/digest and backend after approval

content_input_policy.embedding_text: normalized_title + newline + normalized_content; cap combined representation to 8192 Unicode codepoints under V2; additional model limits require PM-approved pinned preprocessing

label_access_policy.fresh_positive_sufficiency: UNRESOLVED_PM_GATE; prior 120 targeted fresh DEV pairs contained zero observed SAME_EVENT
label_access_policy.selection: only authorized DEV training folds for candidate/threshold selection

pair_universe_policy.historical_disjointness: fresh corpus excludes Home-200 and Gold V2 identities
pair_universe_policy.ordering: frozen artifact ordering; do not regenerate during design
pair_universe_policy.selection: reuse frozen pack identities, disjointness and provenance; lock pair-set hash before evaluation

primary_decision_rule.rule: On identical eligible pair identities, advance only if event identification improves without unacceptable false-merge degradation; report paired uncertainty and abstention. Inadequate evidence means no advancement.

reproducibility.data: pin corpus, sidecar, pair and authorized label artifact hashes
reproducibility.run: pin code SHA, config, split fingerprints, seeds and thresholds

scientific_question: Does frozen article content improve SAME_EVENT identification without unacceptable RELATED_TOPIC false merges on identical pair identities?

threshold_selection_policy.rule: predeclare grids and select using only training folds; freeze before held-out evaluation
